integrity: Proof is an explicit all-parameter cellular collapse and Lefschetz-character enumeration; finite code is corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: No integral exterior-power lattice identification is claimed; results concern exactly two unordered particles and generalized theta graphs with at least three arms. Equivalent unindexed previous representation results remain possible.
title: Arm and pole symmetry of two-point generalized-theta configuration homology
